question: Which chapter of the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa concludes at this point in the text?
premises: The verse uses the concluding particle iti.
It identifies the chapter on the signs of the time of enlightenment as the ninth.
inference: This verse marks the formal conclusion of the ninth chapter on the characteristics of the time of enlightenment in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
plain_english: Thus ends the ninth chapter, on the characteristics of the time of enlightenment, in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
